Long side along the 128" walls: 40.4" at each end closed, 30.6" open (tight:30.6). The light variant of ikea-20600789 (same Measurements rows), chosen for the house style: ash veneer top, legs and frame with a stain and tinted clear acrylic lacquer; wipe clean with a damp cloth. Page: 'Seats 4-6'; the extension leaf adds a seat at each short end. Not badged on this page (the Best seller badge on the search card belongs to the black/brown default). In stock in IKEA Long Island, NY on 2026-10-22. rooms: dining-room, from the staging brief.
